train: The fruit has a hollow core with tiny, edible seeds embedded in its structure.
Color variations include red, black, yellow, and purple, depending on the specific variety.
Each fruit is composed of numerous small drupelets clustered together on a central receptacle.
The surface texture is typically bumpy and covered with fine hairs or tiny glands.
A typical fruit measures around one to five centimeters in diameter when fully ripe.
These fruits grow on perennial plants that can reach heights of one to two meters.
